name: customer_profiles
description: Customer profiles of a European subscription streaming service, with a churn-risk label for ML.
context: Customers are adults across the EU and UK. Plans: basic (1 screen, ads), standard (2 screens), premium (4 screens, 4K), family (up to 6 profiles). Engagement (watch hours) drives churn: customers with low recent watch hours, failed payments or recent support complaints are high risk; long-tenure family/premium customers are usually low risk. Interests shape what they watch. Names and addresses must fit the country.

fields.name: email
fields.description: Personal email derived from the name, on a plausible fictional or common webmail domain.

fields.name: churn_risk
fields.description: Label: must be justified by watch hours, payments, tickets, plan and tenure.

fields.name: account_notes
fields.description: Short internal CRM note, or null.

rules: The address (street, city, postal code format) and phone prefix match the country.
high churn_risk records show clear warning signs (low watch hours, failed payments or recent tickets); low churn_risk records do not.
kids interest is common for family plans and rare for customers under 25 without a family plan.
